breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the standard formula for a simply supported beam with a uniform distributed load (not a resultant point load at midspan). It explicitly states 'The deflection from the distributed load w is calculated using the standard formula for a simply supported beam with a uniform distributed load,' which aligns with the ground truth and avoids the incorrect substitution of the UDL with its resultant acting at midspan.
